name: high-cpu
title: A Serve Aurora instance has sustained high CPU usage
description: An Aurora instance has had average CPU utilisation at or above 85% for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Check the affected database instance and its CPU metrics. Could the high CPU usage be related to recent deployments or expected load?
Review database connections, query activity and Performance Insights. Is this indicative of a query or connection issue causing the high CPU usage?
Is this causing production service degradation or unavailability? If so, an incident will most likely need to be raised.
